title: Prepare a Project for Agentic Development
competency: 01. Toolchain Setup - Repository instructions and engineering skill setup
mission: Prepare a reproducible AGENTS.md and engineering skill collection before starting project development.
domain: Support case routing with ambiguous upcoming requests, ownership rules, existing behavioural tests, and a supplied queue-summary review change.
outcome: A fresh agent discovers the project setup and demonstrates requirements questioning, source-backed research, TDD readiness, and requirements-aware code review.
seededDefects: No project agent instructions or engineering skills are configured.
The upcoming request leaves product decisions unresolved.
The sample review change contains a summary inconsistency and a caller-data mutation.
Personal agent configuration alone cannot be reproduced by another developer.
verificationGates: Application baseline and protected inputs remain intact.
Installed skills cover the four required capabilities and declared dependencies resolve.
Installed resources and project configuration are complete and hash-verified.
The fresh-session setup matches its recorded commit.
Source citations and actual transcript ranges support readiness reports.
Command captures and sealed artifacts match committed evidence.
Human review assesses semantic correctness and actual skill use.
agentWorkflow: Assess the project before writing instructions.
Choose and configure repository instructions and engineering skills.
Commit the setup and start a fresh readiness session.
Demonstrate all four readiness scenarios without implementing a feature.
Record limitations and submit reproducible evidence.
workingDeliverables: Actual session transcript and baseline command capture
Before/after observations, source audit, and sealed verification evidence
